_comment: Mutation testing for the PURE, host-free TypeScript layer only. The mutation suite (npm run test:mutation) is plain mocha with NO VS Code extension host, so each mutant is cheap to verify and the slow e2e/extension-host suite is deliberately NOT mutated. Scope is the two decoupled logic modules with the strongest branch behaviour: htmlUtils (escaping + JSON/HTML builders) and cliResolver (CLI retry policy). StringLiteral mutations are excluded: these modules emit HTML whose exact class names and markup no test asserts, so string mutants are cosmetic noise, not signal — the gate is on the conditional/boolean/arithmetic/logical branch behaviour instead.
